blocks.html: Strudel is the JavaScript port of TidalCycles: live-coded patterns in a browser REPL, built on Web Audio. Sources are official strudel.cc pages unless marked. Items not confirmed on an official page are marked UNVERIFIED. No code below was run in the REPL; syntax follows the documented signatures.

• Every top-level pattern is a line. Prefix with $: to play several at once. Source: https://warm.strudel.cc/learn/faq (mirror of strudel.cc FAQ; confirm on strudel.cc).
  • Prefix with _ (e.g. _$:) to mute a pattern. Same source.
  • stack(...) layers patterns into one. Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/getting-started/
  • arrange([cycles, pattern], ...) sequences sections over cycles, e.g. arrange([2, silence], [18, cello]). pick does indexed selection. Source: https://warm.strudel.cc/learn/faq
  • Tempo: setcpm(x) sets cycles per minute; setcps(x) sets cycles per second; setcpm(x) == setcps(x/60). For BPM in 4/4, use setcpm(BPM/4). Default is 0.5 CPS per https://strudel.cc/understand/cycles/ (a TidalCycles reference lists 0.5625; trust Strudel's page).
  • Comment out a line with //. Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/getting-started/ (the page also notes cmd-/ toggles comments).
  • Chain functions with dots. Double-quoted strings are parsed as mini-notation; single-quoted strings are not. Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/getting-started/

Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/mini-notation/ unless noted.

  • Space separates steps: s("bd sd [~ bd] sd").
  • [ ] subdivides one step; ~ is a rest.
  • < > alternates one event per cycle: note("<e5 b4 d5 c5>").
  • *n speeds up, /n slows down: "[e5 b4 d5 c5]*2", "[e5 b4 d5 c5]/2".
  • !n repeats an event without speeding up: sd!3.
  • @n sets temporal weight: "[a@3 b]" style; default weight 1.
  • ? randomly removes events: hh*8? (50%) or hh*8?0.1.
  • Euclidean: bd(3,8) or bd(3,8,2) (beats, segments, rotation). Source: same page.
  • , plays events together (chord or layer). | picks one at random.
  • Sample index with colon: s("hh:0 hh:1"). Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/samples/

Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/tonal/

  • Note names: letter, optional #/b, optional octave. Octave defaults to 3 when omitted.
  • Scale mapping: n("0 2 4 6").scale("C:minor"). Scale names with spaces use colons ("C:major:blues"). Alternation works: scale("C:<major minor>/2").
  • Chords: chord("<C^7 A7b13 Dm7 G7>*2"). ^ marks major seventh.
  • Voicings: n("0 1 2 3").chord("<C Am F G>").voicing(). Use .mode("root:g2") to set anchoring (modes: below, duck, above, root).
  • Bass root: .rootNotes(2) returns roots in an octave.

• Oscillators: sine, sawtooth (saw), square, triangle. Triangle is the default when only note is given. Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/synths/
  • Supersaw: s("supersaw") appears in a documented example (https://strudel.cc/learn/effects/). Its stereo spread, unison, detune controls come from a release note on a mirror, UNVERIFIED on the official site.
  • Noise: white, pink, brown, crackle.
  • Wavetables: wt_ prefix, e.g. wt_flute.
  • Default sample map includes drums (bd, sd, hh, etc.) and VCSL instruments.
  • Drum machine banks: .bank("RolandTR808") or .bank("<RolandTR808 RolandTR909>").
  • Custom samples: samples({ name: 'path.wav' }, 'https://base/';) or samples('https://.../strudel.json';) or samples('github:tidalcycles/dirt-samples'). Dirt-Samples is not built in. Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/samples/
  • Select variants with n("0 1 2 3").
  • Slicing: chop(4), slice([...], "0 1 ..."), splice(8, ...), loopAt(2), fit(), begin()/end().

Full parameter table in PLUGINS.md. Sources: https://strudel.cc/learn/effects/ unless noted.

  • Filters: lpf/cutoff (0 to 20000 Hz), hpf, bpf, with resonance lpq/hpq/bpq (0 to 50). ftype(0|1|2) picks 12dB, ladder or 24dB.
  • Vowel formant: vowel("a e i o u ...").
  • Reverb: room(level), roomsize(0 to 10), roomlp, roomdim, roomfade.
  • Delay: delay(level 0-1), delaytime(s), delayfeedback(0-1).
  • Distortion: crush(1-16), coarse(factor), distort(amount).
  • Levels and pan: gain, velocity (0-1), postgain, pan(0-1), jux(fn), juxBy(0-1).
  • Phaser: phaser(speed), phaserdepth(0-1), phasercenter, phasersweep.
  • Routing: orbit(n) groups effects and ducking.

Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/effects/ and https://strudel.cc/learn/synths/

  • Amplitude: attack, decay, sustain (level 0-1), release. Shorthand adsr(".1:.1:.5:.2").
  • Filter envelope: lpattack, lpdecay, lpsustain, lpenv (depth). Same family exists for hp* and bp*.
  • Pitch envelope: pattack, pdecay, prelease, penv (semitones), pcurve (0 linear, 1 exponential).

Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/signals/

  • Continuous: sine, cosine, saw, tri, square (0 to 1); *2 variants give -1 to 1.
  • Random: rand, perlin, irand(n), brand, brandBy(p).
  • Shape with .range(lo, hi) and sample with .segment(n). .slow(n) stretches. clip() clamps.
  • Example: s("bd*4,hh*8").cutoff(perlin.range(500,8000)).

Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/effects/

  • duckorbit(n) targets another orbit; duckattack(s) sets recovery; duckdepth(0-1) sets depth.
  • Example: $: s("bd:4!4").beat("0,4,8,11,14",16).duckorbit(2).duckattack(0.2).duckdepth(1).
  • Put the kick on a different orbit from the pad it ducks.

• Keep one pattern per line; mute with _$: instead of deleting.
  • Use setcpm once at the top; avoid many tempo changes.
  • orbit(n) routes a pattern's effects to a group; it is also what duckorbit targets (the grouping advice itself is UNVERIFIED).
  • Large sample banks load slowly; use samples() once and reuse names.
  • Use _punchcard() or _pianoroll() to check rhythm visually. Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/visual-feedback/

• Mini-notation only works inside double quotes; 'C minor' is a plain string.
  • ? is random: each event is removed by chance, so the result varies between cycles. Seeded repeatability is UNVERIFIED.
  • n() indices wrap; out-of-range values do not error.
  • .sometimesBy(p, fn) is per event, .someCyclesBy(p, fn) is per cycle. Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/random-modifiers/
  • Filter frequencies above 20000 Hz are inaudible; resonance above ~30 gets harsh (judgement, UNVERIFIED).
  • Recheck setcpm after changing bar length; it is cycles, not bars.
